Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to

minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 5. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Column Oven a) Maximum Oven Operating Temperature: Up to 450°C or higher b) Cool Down Time: 450°C to 50°C in less than 4 minutes c) Number of Oven Ramps: 9/10 or more d) Number of Injection Ports: 2 e) Maximum Injection Port Heating Temperature: Up to 400°C or higher f) Pressure Range: Up to 120 psi or higher

g) Sample Injection Port: Split/splitless with Split Ratio of 6000:1 or more (or iscon Packed c olumn / compatible) 2. Headspace Sampler a) Capacity: Headspace sampler with 60 or more vials, with simultaneous heating of 12 vials at a time b) Operating Temperature Range: Up to 200°C or better c) Peak Area Repeatability: < 1.5% RSD d) Carry-over: Less than 0.0001% 4. Environmental Conditions a) Operating Temperature: Up to 40°C b) Operating Humidity (RH): Up to 95% 5. Validated Software a) Latest version of validated Windows-based GC-FID-HS Software. b) Instrument control via external computer. c) Original licensed software must be supplied for the entire system (perpetual license for the validated software). 6. Computer System a) Latest version branded PC compatible with software and system for smooth operation. b) Monitor: Branded 24" or higher LED monitor. c) Processor: Intel Core i7 Processor (13th generation Intel or higher). d) Memory: 32 GB RAM or higher. e) Operating System: Windows-based operating system compatible with the latest validate d software (supplied with Media and documentation). f) Graphics: 2 GB dedicated graphics. g) Keyboard & Mouse: Optical wireless. h) Storage: 1 TB HDD/SSD. 7. Printer ● Laserjet black & white printer. 8. Accessories & Infrastructure a) Capillary Column (Polar, Non-Polar): 2 of each type. b) Capillary Columns: (30 m × 0.25 mm × 0.25 µm) DB-ALC1 & DB-ALC2 or equivalent: 2 No s. each (Total of 4 columns). c) Headspace Syringe: 5 nos. d) Graphite ferrules: 50 nos. e) Vespel ferrules: 20 nos. f) Septa: High-temperature and low-bleed Septa: 100 nos. g) Inlet liner for split/splitless: 10 nos. each. h) O-rings: 10 nos. of each type. i) Cutters: Column Cutter: 2 nos., Gas tube Cutter: 2 nos. j) Column Nut: 10 nos. k) Tool Kit: 1 no.

l) Spares and Consumables: All spares and consumables required for the 3-year warranty p eriod or for a 2000-sample run. m) Availability of Spares: At least 7 years from the date of installation. n) Manuals: User / Technical / Maintenance Manual. o) Lab Infrastructure - Table: 8 feet × 4 feet. p) UPS: 5 KVA UPS with 1-hour backup. q) Gas Purification Panel: For all gases (H2, N2 and zero air) equipped with moisture trap, h ydrocarbon trap, and oxygen trap. 9. Installation, Commissioning, Warranty, & Training a) Qualification: IQ/OQ/PQ qualification. b) Training: 5 days of onsite training to be provided to the test scientists. c) Warranty: 3 years warranty on the entire system, including peripherals. 10. General Conditions a) Onsite visit prior to installation for site readiness assessment. b) Maintenance Contract: 5 years Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) rate must be quoted post-warranty date, inclusive of 4 Preventive Maintenance (PM) visits and breakdown visits as and when required. c) Documentation: All technical specifications must be supported by printed leaflets/brochur es/OEM certification or substantiated on the authentic official website. d) Certifications: ISO/GLP/GMP/CE certification compliance. . 38.
